description: Risk-level-based policy engine. Evaluates capability risk level against configured thresholds. Mirrors engine/runtime/policy.py::RiskLevelPolicyEngine.
instructions: Read the capability's risk_level from its descriptor (low, medium, high, critical).
Compare against a configured threshold (e.g., deny above medium).
Return ALLOW for permitted levels, REQUIRE_APPROVAL for warning levels, DENY for blocked levels.
Configuration is set at engine level, not per-task.
